verdict.rationale: Morph's docs say to point any OpenAI SDK at https://api.morphllm.com/v1 with one API key, and say existing OpenAI code only needs a new model string. The llms.txt probe confirms the endpoint is OpenAI-compatible, and a community user independently got it working through an OpenAI-compatible client. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of which OpenAI API parameters and features are compatible, and acknowledgment that a model-name change is also required beyond the base URL and key.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point an existing OpenAI SDK client at the provider by changing only the base URL and API key
